name: Margin card host
description: Shared card surface on the right edge of the page. Other plugins mount streaming answer cards via the 'margin' service; the page_reader tool lets an agent hide non-main content to enter a reading mode with a real margin. Disabled = zero DOM.

extraTools.name: page_reader
extraTools.description: Clean up the page for reading: hides everything outside the main content so the page gets a real right margin (enter), restores it (exit), or reports state (status). Answered on the page by the margin plugin.

action.description: enter = hide non-main content and dock cards in the freed margin; exit = restore the page; status = current mode/card count.

tabId.description: Target tab (defaults to the chat's current tab).

prompt: The margin plugin hosts answer cards on the page's right edge. Use page_reader(action:'enter') before long reading/analysis tasks so the page keeps only its main content; call 'exit' when done. Cards are created page-side by other plugins, not by tools.
